toolchain.host: Windows 11 / Podman 6.1.4 / Debian bookworm container guix-work
toolchain.hardeningPatch: lib/chibi/emscripten.sld exports nothing; eval-script!/load-script! are unavailable to guests

chibi.cjs.role: Emscripten glue plus __CHIBI_PROGRAM__ host injection patch

fixed-aot.reason: Chibi runs a Scheme VM; this experiment evaluates runtime eval, not whole-program AOT.

pure-dynamic.smoke: 3/3 minimum operations passed: eval, dynamic registration plus call, isolated eval
pure-dynamic.corpus: 15/31 fixtures passed; remaining failures are missing plugin library forms, unmapped error codes, stateful adapter gaps, and expected runtime semantic differences

async-ffi.reason: No async FFI mechanism was exercised in this smoke.

security.evidence: escape.mjs importing (chibi emscripten) and calling eval-script! fails with undefined variable: eval-script!
security.note: The Emscripten glue still exposes standard env/WASI imports; guests are not given a raw JS bridge.

isolation.process: each invocation runs boot.mjs in a child process
isolation.statePersistence: adapter currently spawns one process per request; cross-request state is not provided

decision: Chibi is the first candidate to pass the pure-dynamic eval/register/isolated minimum with a blocked JS escape hatch. Do not claim fixed AOT or async FFI support; stateful ops and memory limits remain open.
